response.text: Two things need a closer look: one unbalanced journal (debits exceed credits by 9.00 overall), and one account code not in the chart of accounts. I'll identify both, plus the one negative invoice and the one reference-journal row.

arguments.sql: SELECT 'unbalanced' k, "JRNL_NO" j, SUM("DR_AMT") dr, SUM("CR_AMT") cr, NULL a FROM "GLJRNL" GROUP BY "JRNL_NO" HAVING SUM("DR_AMT") <> SUM("CR_AMT") UNION ALL SELECT 'bad_acct', "JRNL_NO", "LN_SEQ", NULL, "ACCT_CD" FROM "GLJRNL" l WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "GLCOA" a WHERE a."ACCT_CD"=l."ACCT_CD") UNION ALL SELECT 'neg_inv', "INV_ID", "INV_AMT", NULL, "VEND_CD" FROM "APINVH" WHERE "INV_AMT"<0 UNION ALL SELECT 'ref_jrnl', "JRNL_NO", "REF_JRNL_NO", NULL, "MEMO" FROM "GLJRNH" WHERE "REF_JRNL_NO" IS NOT NULL;
